description: A request of the runner to an adapter, as one line on its standard input: does a accept every instance that is valid under b?

a.description: The schema that should accept everything.

b.description: The schema whose instances must be accepted.

timeout.description: The seconds that the checker may take. The runner waits a little longer and then kills the adapter, so an adapter need not keep to it.

Schema.description: A schema of the draft that the checker reads: of draft 2020-12 as the corpus has it, or rewritten to an older draft.
